mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is linear and continuous, with no threshold effect.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 260 indicates persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of negative returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 144000) combined with high housing demand (HOUST > 1400) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The interaction effect is multiplicative: the positive signal is only strong when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS > 144000 and HOUST > 1400, or the interaction term in a regression of 5-day returns on PAYEMS and HOUST is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5%), a higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of negative returns in high unemployment regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply-side economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is linear and continuous, with no threshold effect.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 1400 indicates strong housing demand, signaling a robust economy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of positive returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 144000) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 144000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of positive returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is linear and continuous, with no threshold effect.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
